audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phase reasons are shared template text keyed to 'Body Slam's cooldown' with no numbers and nothing about Drunken Rage.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1 and Drunken Rage only 5s — the short cooldown is the one that decides whether your burst lands, because the drink reduces the damage he takes.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around Drunken Rage's damage reduction, Body Slam's 14s engage and Explosive Cask's knockback.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 stage said only 'his ultimate changes the math too' and the item stages named no reason.
audit.why: Explosive Cask is 100s at rank 1 and knocks you back — at 6 it can displace you mid-rotation, which matters more than the raw damage. Your spike is Lich Bane on his 14s Body Slam gap.
audit.corrected: phases[4] now names the cask and the displacement; phases[5] and phases[6] key your all-ins to Body Slam being spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Drunken Rage was never mentioned. It reduces the damage he receives, which is exactly what eats an Akali rotation, and Happy Hour heals him every time he casts.
audit.why: Riot's description: Drunken Rage makes him 'deal magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received'; Happy Hour 'periodically heals upon using a skill'. champ-data/_kits/_missing/akali.json flags the healing for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Damage reduction stated in phases[2].why, tradeBad and report[5].t; the healing and its anti-heal answer in phases[3].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer.
audit.why: Body Slam 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, Barrel Roll 10s at rank 1, Drunken Rage 5s flat, Explosive Cask 100s at rank 1; your W is 20s and E 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Get R-knocked into his team' was described as diving with no shroud and no energy.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title.

edits.before: Shroud his E-Q — build MR, Q-poke him. Akali wins the Body Slam cooldown windows.
edits.after: Shroud his E-Q — build MR, bait the drink. Akali wins the Body Slam cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud his combo and poke him down. Track Body Slam before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud his combo and poke him down. Body Slam is 14s at rank 1 — that gap is your kill window.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Gragas contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Barrel Roll reaches 850 to your 550 kunai and costs him nothing but mana. Farm at Q tip and take no trades.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Gragas's Body Slam is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts, and his Body Slam needs a body to collide with.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gragas must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Drunken Rage cuts the damage he takes for a second — never dump your rotation into the drink.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Body Slam's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Happy Hour heals him every cast, so short bursts on Body Slam's 14s beat any extended chip war.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gragas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Explosive Cask (100s) knocks you back — it can displace you out of your own second dash.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Body Slam's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight the moment his Body Slam has been spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Gragas carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and one rotation kills him, but his cask is a teamfight tool — do not stand where it can throw you.

edits.before: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — His engage. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Body Slam (14s at rank 1): his engage, and it needs to collide with you. - Drunken Rage (5s): the drink cuts damage he takes — never burst into it. - Explosive Cask (100s): knockback off your own dash.

edits.before: Q Gragas at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550, E-mark and dash in once Body Slam is spent, then Shroud his barrel detonation.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Dumping your rotation into a fresh Drunken Rage — the drink eats it and Happy Hour heals the rest.

edits.before: Q Gragas at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: His whole kit is magic damage, so magic resist actually reads on every barrel and slam here.

edits.before: Gragas wastes Body Slam — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Body Slam needs a body to hit; from smoke it collides with nothing.

edits.before: That is Gragas's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The slam stun into a detonated barrel is his whole kill pattern — break it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The cask grows more potent the longer it sits before it blows.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Explosive Cask knocks you back, so it can throw you clean out of your own second R dash.

edits.before: Track Gragas's Body Slam: His engage. Shroud-dodge it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Body Slam (14s) is his engage and must collide. Drunken Rage cuts damage he takes.
